name: Aozora Hibari
source:
Occupation: Student in Kansai

Subject: Arithmetic (elementary arithmetic)

Personality: A trouble-maker with a flair for the unexpected. She is a free-spirited person, and he is also a selfish person in the main character's house. She is the sixth daughter of the Aozora sisters.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/katei/cha/hib01.html]official site[/url]]
